page.title: Refer a business
page.description: Share your link yourself, for example on WhatsApp. We never message people on your behalf and never read your contacts.
page.step1Body: The business signs up through your link. Signing up alone earns nothing.
page.step2Body: They get verified (GST) and publish a first approved listing, or send a first verified enquiry.
page.step3Body: After a 7-day safety check, you and they each get {credits} lead credits. Credits, never cash. They expire after 90 days.
page.footnote: There is no deadline and no bonus that grows or expires to pressure you. Each business can be referred once. You can earn from up to {cap} referrals per quarter. Referring yourself or accounts you control is not rewarded.
page.emptyDesc: Share your link with a supplier or buyer you trust.
page.holdReward: Reward on {date}, after our safety check.
page.reviewing: Our team is reviewing this referral before releasing credits.
page.rewardedNote: {count, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} added to both accounts.
